column3: 2   Free sugar includes sucrose, fructose, glucose, honey, syrups, starch sweeteners (glucose syrup, glucose-fructose syrups), sugar concentrates, other similar sugar preparations, fruit and berry juices
and juice concentrates used as such or added to foods during preparation at home or in the food industry. The sugars contained in vegetables, berries and fruits eaten as such and used for cooking are
not included in the definition of free sugar.
